# laravelforge_site_laravel_maintenance (Resource)

Enables Laravel maintenance mode for a Laravel Forge site. This is a singleton integration: the presence of the resource means maintenance mode is enabled, and destroying it disables it. The Forge API exposes no update endpoint, so changing any writable input recreates the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server that owns the site.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site to enable maintenance mode on.
- `status_code` (Number) The HTTP status code returned while in maintenance mode. One of 304, 307, 410, 503.

### Optional

- `redirect` (String) The redirect URL to which all requests are sent while in maintenance mode.
- `secret` (String) The secret phrase that allows access to the application while in maintenance mode.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the maintenance mode integration is enabled.
- `laravel_installed` (Boolean) Whether Laravel is installed on the site.
- `status` (String) The status of the maintenance mode integration (`enabling` or `disabling`).
